commentary.speaker: Greer
commentary.text: Alright, Eli. We step through that gate, we stay sharp. Watch each other's six.

commentary.speaker: Dr Park
commentary.text: The atmospheric readings are within tolerance. We should have about ten minutes before we need to head back.

commentary.speaker: Greer
commentary.text: Holding position. We'll watch the perimeter.

commentary.speaker: Greer
commentary.text: Covering fire! Keep your head down!

commentary.speaker: Dr Park
commentary.text: Excellent — these mineral deposits are exactly what we need. The Destiny's filtration system can use these.

commentary.speaker: Dr Park
commentary.text: These ruins... they're Ancient in origin. The architecture matches the gate designs. We need to document everything.

commentary.speaker: Greer
commentary.text: That device — I've seen Rush light up over less. Let's grab it and get out of here.

commentary.speaker: Greer
commentary.text: Contact! Hostiles at our twelve o'clock!

commentary.speaker: Dr Park
commentary.text: We're running out of time. The gate window is closing — we need to head back now.

commentary.speaker: Greer
commentary.text: Time to go. Back through the gate, everyone! Move!

commentary.speaker: Greer
commentary.text: Something doesn't feel right about this place.

commentary.speaker: Dr Park
commentary.text: The geological formations here are fascinating. If only we had more time to study them.

commentary.speaker: Greer
commentary.text: Eli, stay focused. We've got a job to do.
